Title: Teaching and Learning Enhancement Workshop
NewsSummary: The Network of Teaching & Learning conducted third Teaching and Learning Enhancement Workshop for AKU Pakistan faculty in Karachi on October 11-13, 2017.
NewsContent:
The Network of Teaching & Learning conducted third Teaching and Learning Enhancement Workshop for AKU Pakistan faculty in Karachi on October 11-13, 2017. The course was offered to 27 AKU East Africa faculty drawn from all the entities in Dar es Salaam on 25th - 27th July, 2016 and in Karachi on 28-30th September, 2016. The programme is approved by Academic Council in February 2016 and is mandatory course for faculty who have been employed in AKU for five years and less. Older and more experienced faculty are also eligible to attend as the format of the programme is flexible enough to accommodate faculty of varied experience levels.

The workshop aimed at supporting participants develop increased competence and confidence as facilitators of learning as well as provided them with resources to be more reflective about their teaching. It engaged 25 faculty members of different disciplines in planning the lessons, teaching them in the small groups and getting feedback from peers. All participants stated that TLEW significantly enhanced their awareness as instructors. Around 95% of the participants stated that they improved their lesson planning skills and lesson delivery through peer-feedback in TLEW. Some of the participants (n=5) stated that, they found the lesson planning framework 'BOPPPS' very effective and powerful and they will use the same to structure their lessons. 

The workshop also encouraged participants to use different teaching and learning strategies and provided a safe-space for bringing innovations in teaching and learning. One participant stated, "Working in smaller group-provided safe and active learning environment." Another participant stated that, "facilitators were very helpful and supportive in bringing out the best in everyone."

The workshop is held every year in Pakistan and every other year in East Africa. Keep visiting our website and be the first one to subscribe for the workshop - as we always have limited seats for this one! More information can be found at :
